_comment: Confirmed TRUE cognate root correspondences that the automatic root-inflation check would otherwise demote (metathesis and other irregular-but-real correspondences). A listed (ar_root, he_root) pair is trusted: it may seed root-family expansion and its pairs are not flagged root_mismatch. Promote entries here from the root-inflation review report after checking the literature; bans live in false-positives.json.
_wsy_note: Arabic w-ṣ-y 'enjoin, bequeath' ↔ Hebrew ṣ-w-h 'command' (מצוה, צואה): standard comparison (Gesenius, Klein) with root metathesis; the inflation check cannot align the transposed radicals.
_ghtl_note: Arabic ġ-ṭ-l (غَيْطَلَة 'darkness, dense murk') ↔ Hebrew ʕ-l-ṭ (עֲלָטָה 'darkness'): same sense, regular ġ↔ʕ correspondence with root metathesis (ġ-ṭ-l ~ ʕ-l-ṭ); the inflation check cannot align the transposed radicals.
